attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: যার গুণ বা ফল ইতিবাচক, তাকে good বলা হয়।

definition.oewn_definition: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
definition.text: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified

quoted_examples: when she was good she was very very good
a good knife is one good for cutting
this stump will make a good picnic table
a good dress for the office

examples.bn: প্রতিরাত পড়ে সে ভালো ফল করেছিল।
examples.en: She got a good result after studying every night.
